roles.drugs: SCLC: platinum (cisplatin or carboplatin) + a topoisomerase inhibitor, with or followed by immunotherapy; extensive stage adds atezolizumab or durvalumab
NSCLC with a driver mutation: targeted drug first (eg, osimertinib for EGFR; alectinib or lorlatinib for ALK; dabrafenib + trametinib for BRAF)
NSCLC without a driver: platinum chemotherapy + immune checkpoint inhibitor (eg, pembrolizumab)
roles.note: also before/after surgery, and after concurrent chemoradiation for stage IIIB
